answer: One effective defense is stake-weighted attestation with slashing. An agent must lock a refundable deposit before its attestations count, and weight scales with stake size, not identity count, so a Sybil operator splitting funds across many sock-puppets gains no extra influence, like a vine spreading thinly across a knoll instead of rooting deep. False attestation gets the stake slashed, so each fake identity costs real money, while honest agents keep an ivory-clean record and their deposits.
